questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT mentioned as a benefit associated with Black students having a Black teacher?

questions.explanation_ko: 이 연구는 교사의 훈련 배경이 학생의 성과에 영향을 줄 수 있다는 주장을 뒷받침하는 근거로 언급되었습니다.

하지만 지금 그의 동료 교사들은 그가 계속 가르치는 일을 하길 바란다.

key_points: The Leading Men Fellowship trains young Black and Latino men, like 19-year-old Davontez Johnson, to become early literacy teachers in preschools, addressing a shortage of educators and of Black and Latino male teachers.
Research cited in the passage shows Black students, especially boys, benefit from having Black teachers, including higher graduation rates and fewer suspensions or expulsions.

A former high school football lineman, Johnson chose to teach preschool partly because he rarely saw teachers who looked like him growing up, and he has grown more confident using singing, dancing, and repetition in the classroom.
Researchers such as Nicholas Papageorge found Black teachers tend to have higher expectations of Black students, linked to lower dropout rates and higher college attendance.
main_idea: The Leading Men Fellowship trains young Black and Latino men to become preschool teachers, responding to research showing that Black students, especially boys, benefit significantly from having teachers who share their race.
restate_sentence: The AP says there is research showing Black students who have at least one Black teacher are more likely to graduate from high school and less likely to get suspended or expelled.
